Method of Attack: Execution of PowerShell scripts for payload delivery and lateral movement
Use of backdoors (DiceLoader/Tirion) for persistence and control
Credential theft from Veeam backup database
Lateral movement using stolen credentials via SMB protocol and WMI invocations
Attack Vector: Public web accessible Veeam Backup and Replication servers
Open TCP port 9401 on compromised servers
Indicators of Compromise: Suspicious alerts such as sqlservr.exe spawning cmd.exe and downloading PowerShell scripts
Use of custom PowerShell scripts for reconnaissance and lateral movement
SMB communication protocol usage to drop PowerShell scripts onto administrative shares
